questions.question:
[지문]
We didn't spend much time on planning. All the members started building the tower right away.

주어진 글에 이어질 내용의 순서로 가장 알맞은 것은?
questions.explanation: 글의 흐름상 먼저 첫 번째 탑을 만들었고 (B), 그 다음 두 번째 탑이 실패했고 (A), 마지막으로 성공한 탑을 완성했다 (C)는 순서가 자연스럽다.

options: Amy wants to know how the game went.
Mike is satisfied with his team's teamwork.
Amy feels sorry about the result of the game.
Mike is ashamed of losing the game by one point.
Amy is looking forward to watching Mike's next game.
questions.question:
[대화]
Amy: Mike, did your team win the basketball game?
Mike: Our team lost.
Amy: Oh, I'm sorry to hear that.
Mike: It's okay. It was a great game.
Amy: What was the score?
Mike: It was 80 to 79. We lost by one point.
Amy: That was really close!
Mike: Yeah. We played really well as a team.
Amy: That's wonderful! I want to watch your next game.

다음 대화의 내용과 다른 것을 고르시오.
questions.explanation: Mike는 'It's okay. It was a great game'이라고 말하며 패배에 대해 부끄러워하지 않고 있다. 오히려 팀워크에 만족하고 있다.

options:
A: It's good to see you.
B: Me, too. How have you been?

A: How was your vacation?
B: Not so good. I broke my arm.

A: Ann, you look upset today.
B: I had a fight with my best friend.

A: Hana, is that you? Long time no see.
B: Yes, it will take a long time.

A: You know what? Our class won the soccer game.
B: Really? I am happy to hear that.
questions.question: 다음 대화 중 가장 어색한 것을 고르시오.
questions.explanation: ④번에서 'Long time no see'는 '오랜만이야'라는 인사말인데, B의 '네, 오래 걸릴 것 같아요'라는 답변은 문맥상 어색하다. 'Yes, it has been a long time'이나 'Yes, I missed you' 정도가 적절하다.

options: 탑 쌓기를 계획하는 데 많은 시간을 소비했다.
두 번째 만들어진 탑은 텐트처럼 낮고 튼튼했다.
여러 번 시도 끝에 완성된 탑은 높고 아름다웠다.
첫 번째 만들어진 탑은 피사의 사탑처럼 아주 높았다.
실수를 거듭한 끝에 결국 원하는 탑을 완성하지 못했다.
questions.question:
[지문]
TEAM B : Just do it.
We didn't think or plan for a long time. All the members started building the tower right away. Our first tower was like a tent. It wasn't very tall so we tried again. The next tower was tall but it couldn't stand by itself. After many tries, we finally built a beautiful and tall tower. It looked like the Leaning Tower of Pisa. We finally made what we wanted!

다음 글의 내용과 일치하는 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.explanation: 텍스트에서 'After many tries, we finally built a beautiful and tall tower'라고 명시되어 있다.

questions.question:
[지문]
Instead, we took a good idea and improved on it.

TEAM C
We're one team.
We didn't try to choose the best idea. (A) One student said we needed a strong base. (B) Another student suggested a triangle shape for the base. (C) We all agreed and each one had roles such as time checker and tape cutter. (D) We worked together as a team. In the end, we built our tall tower! (E)

문맥상 주어진 문장이 들어갈 위치로 (A)~(E)중 가장 알맞은 곳은?
questions.explanation: 주어진 문장 'Instead, we took a good idea and improved on it'은 '최고의 아이디어를 선택하지 않는 대신' 이라는 부분 직후에 와야 하므로, 'We didn't try to choose the best idea' 다음인 (A) 위치가 가장 적절하다.

options: I saw what he did last night.
They can easily find that they need.
Which she says is different from which she does.
Did you bring the thing what you bought yesterday?
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 가장 올바른 문장은?
questions.explanation: ②번 'I saw what he did last night'가 올바르다. ①은 'All that I have', ③은 'They can easily find what they need', ④는 'What she says', ⑤는 'the thing that you bought' 형태가 정확하다.

options:
A: What's the matter?
B: I broke my arm.

A: How was your vacation?
B: I am happy to hear that.

A: I had a fight with my friend.
B: Really? I'm sorry to hear that.

A: How have you been?
B: Great. I have worked out for 2 months.

A: Can you tell me how to recycle the cans?
B: Well, I'm not sure.
questions.question: 다음 대화 중 가장 어색한 것은?
questions.explanation: ②번에서 A가 'How was your vacation?'이라고 물었는데, B가 'I am happy to hear that'이라고 답하는 것은 어색하다. B가 자신의 휴가에 대해 답해야 하므로 'It was great' 같은 표현이 적절하다.

options: Your tower must have the marshmallow on the base of your tower.
Each team has to make the tallest tower within 15 minutes.
You have to prepare four materials for the Marshmallow Challenge.
You can make yourself creative through this activity.
questions.question:
[지문]
Try the Marshmallow Challenge!
You need: 20 sticks of spaghetti, 1 marshmallow, 1 meter of tape, 1 meter of string.
Rules:
- Each team has four people.
- You have to build the tallest tower in your class.
- The marshmallow must be on top.
- The tower must stand by itself.
- The time limit is 15 minutes.
This activity is good for: Building Relationship, Solving Problems, Thinking Creatively

Marshmallow Challenge에 관한 글의 내용과 다른 것을 고르시오.
questions.explanation: 글에서 'The marshmallow must be on top'이라고 명시되어 있는데, ②번은 '마시멜로우가 탑의 밑바닥에 있어야 한다'고 잘못 기술했다.

questions.question:
[주어진 말]
How did the basketball game go yesterday? I heard that it was really close.

주어진 말 다음에 이어질 대화의 흐름상 가장 자연스러운 순서는?
questions.explanation: 자연스러운 대화 순서는: 첫 번째 (D) '점수가 뭐였어?'로 구체적인 정보를 요청하고, (A) '80대 79였어'로 답변하고, (B) '정말 가까웠겠네'라고 동의하고, (C) '다음 경기 보고 싶어'로 마무리하는 것이 자연스럽다. 따라서 (B)-(D)-(A)-(C) 순서이다.

options: A: I ___ⓐ___ with my boy friend.
I had to go home ___ⓔ___, so I left the party early.
The company should ___ⓕ___ on the water pollution.
Can you ___ⓖ___ the meaning of this word in the dictionary?
If you think it's too fast, tell me to ___ⓓ___.
questions.question:
[보기]
ⓐ broke down ⓑ had a fight ⓒ in a hurry
ⓓ let down ⓔ in detail ⓕ take action
ⓖ look forward ⓗ slow down

빈칸에 들어갈 말을 <보기>에서 올바르게 선택한 것은?
questions.explanation: 각 빈칸에 맞는 표현: ①had a fight (ⓑ) ②in detail (ⓔ) ③take action (ⓕ) ④look up (이미지에 주어진 보기와 맞지 않음) ⑤slow down (ⓗ). 정정하면: ①ⓑ ②ⓔ ③ⓕ ④look up ⑤ⓗ

options: He broke which I gave him.
My mother loved that I made for her.
I could cheer up thanks to she said what.
Tell me the thing which you did last night.
Kate couldn't remember which you did last night.
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 적절한 것을 고르시오.
questions.explanation: ④번 'Tell me the thing which you did last night'가 올바르다. ①은 'He broke what I gave him', ②는 'My mother loved what I made for her', ③은 'I could cheer up thanks to what she said', ⑤는 'Kate couldn't remember what you did last night' 형태가 정확하다.

options: Mina wants to watch Andy's next game.
Mina isn't interested in the basketball game.
Mina will play the basketball game with Andy.
Mina thinks Andy's team didn't show a good teamwork.
questions.question:
[대화]
Mina: Andy, how did the basketball game go?
Andy: Our team lost.
Mina: Oh, I'm sorry to hear that.
Andy: It's okay. It was a great game.
Mina: What was the score?
Andy: It was 80 to 79. We lost by one point.
Mina: That was really close!
Andy: Yeah. We played really well as a team.
Mina: That's wonderful! I want to watch your next game.

다음 대화의 내용과 일치하는 것을 고르시오.
questions.explanation: 대화의 마지막 부분에서 Mina가 'That's wonderful! I want to watch your next game'이라고 말했으므로, ②번이 정확히 일치한다.

questions.question:
빈칸에 들어갈 말이 나머지와 다른 것은?

① It is dangerous _____ her to ride a horse.
② It is silly ______ him to give up the work.
③ It was careless _____ you to leave his wallet on the bus.
④ It is smart _____ her to solve the math problem.
⑤ It was rude _____ him to ignore her invitation.
questions.explanation: 문장 ①은 'It is dangerous for her to ride a horse'이므로 전치사 'for'가 들어가야 합니다. 나머지는 모두 'of'가 들어갑니다. '감정이나 의견을 나타내는 형용사(silly, careless, rude, smart)' 뒤에는 'of'를 사용하고, '상황이나 조건을 나타내는 형용사(dangerous)' 뒤에는 'for'를 사용합니다.

questions.question:
어법상 옳은 것을 고르시오.

① It is easy of him to solve the problem.
② It was silly of him to give up the work.
③ It was kind for her to take care of my pet.
④ It is important of them to do their homework.
⑤ It was impossible of her to climb the mountain.
questions.explanation: 정답은 ②번입니다. 'silly'는 감정이나 의견을 나타내는 형용사이므로 'of'를 사용하는 것이 맞습니다. ①은 'easy'이므로 'for'를 사용해야 하고(It is easy for him), ③은 'kind'이므로 'of'를 사용해야 하며(It was kind of her), ④의 'important'는 'for'를 사용하고(It is important for them), ⑤의 'impossible'은 'for'를 사용해야 합니다(It was impossible for her).

questions.question:
[지문]
Try the Marshmallow Challenge!
You need:
20 sticks of spaghetti
1 marshmallow
1 meter of tape
1 meter of string
Rules:
- Each team has four people.
- You have to build the tallest tower is your class.
- The marshmallow must be on top.
- The tower must stand by itself.
- The time limit is 15 minutes.
This activity is good for:
Building Relationships
Solving Problems
Thinking Creatively

다음 글의 내용과 일치하는 것을 고르시오.

① The height limit of the tower is 1 meter.
② You have to put the marshmallow on top.
③ You have to finish this activity in 4 minutes.
④ You must divide marshmallow into four pieces.
⑤ You must make the strongest tower in your class.
questions.explanation: 지문의 Rules에 'The marshmallow must be on top.'이라고 명시되어 있으므로 ②번이 정답입니다. ①은 높이 제한이 언급되지 않았고, ③은 시간 제한이 15분이지 4분이 아니며, ④는 마시멜로우를 나누는 것이 명시되지 않았고, ⑤는 '가장 키가 큰' 탑이지 '가장 강한' 탑이 아닙니다.

questions.question:
밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중에서 대화의 흐름상 알맞지 않은 것은?

Boy: Linda! Is that you? ⓐ Long time no see.
Girl: Minho! It's been a long time.
Boy: ⓑ How have you been?
Girl: I'be been good. How about you?
Boy: I've been really busy at school. ⓒ How's your new school?
Girl: It's wonderful. I've made many new friends.
Boy: ⓓ That's great! I'm happy to hear that.
Girl: Thanks. Oh! I have to go to my violin lesson now.
Boy: ⓔ This looks interesting. What is it for?
Girl: Yeah. I'll call you later. Have a good day!
Boy: You, too. Bye!
questions.explanation: ⓔ 'This looks interesting. What is it for?'는 대화의 흐름상 어색합니다. Linda가 '바이올린 레슨에 가야 한다'고 말한 직후이므로, Boy가 갑자기 '이것이 뭔가?'라고 물어보는 것은 자연스럽지 않습니다. Boy는 Linda의 상황을 이해하고 있어야 합니다.

questions.question:
(A), (B) 두 대화에서 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중, 흐름상 어색한 것은?

(A)
Girl: Andy, how did the basketball game go?
Boy: Our team lost.
Girl: ⓐ Oh, I'm sorry to hear that.
Boy: It's okay. It was a great game.
Girl: What was the score?
Boy: ⓑ It was 80 to 79. We lost by one point.
Girl: That was really close!
Boy: ⓒ I had to take him to the subway station.
Girl: That's wonderful! I want to watch your net game.

(B)
Girl: Hi, Jinsu! We're in the same class again!
Boy: Yeah! It's good to see you, Sora. How have you been?
Girl: ⓓ I've been great. How about you?
Boy: I've been pretty busy. I have a piano competition next week.
Girl: Oh! I didn't know you played the piano.
Boy: Really? I've played the piano for 5 years.
Girl: ⓔ You must be good at it. Good luck in your competition!
Boy: Thanks.
questions.explanation: ⓒ 'I had to take him to the subway station.'은 대화의 흐름상 어색합니다. 농구 경기 점수에 대한 이야기를 하다가 갑자기 '누군가를 지하철역에 데려가야 했다'는 내용이 나오는 것은 맥락과 맞지 않습니다.

questions.question:
[지문]
Minho: Linda! Is that you? Long time no see.
Linda: Minho! It's been a long time.
Minho: How have you been?
Linda: I've been good. How about you?
Minho: I've been really busy at school. How's your new school?
Linda: It's wonderful. I've made many new friends.
Minho: That's great! I'm happy to hear that.
Linda: Thanks. Oh! I have to go to my violin lesson now.
Minho: You still have my number, right?
Linda: Yeah, I'll call you later. Have a good day!
Minho: You, too. Bye!

다음 대화를 읽고 대화 내용에서 답을 찾을 수 없는 질문은?

① How has Minho been at school?
② Do Linda and Minho go to the same school?
③ Have Linda and Minho met after a long time?
④ How does Minho feel about Linda's new school life?
⑤ How long did it take for Linda to make new friends?
questions.explanation: ①은 'I've been really busy at school'에서, ②는 대화의 맥락에서 다른 학교에 다니는 것으로 알 수 있고, ③은 'Long time no see'에서, ④는 'That's great! I'm happy to hear that'에서 찾을 수 있습니다. 하지만 ⑤는 Linda가 새로운 친구들을 만드는 데 얼마나 걸렸는지는 대화에서 언급되지 않았습니다.

questions.question:
다음 중 단어의 영어 뜻풀이가 옳은 것은?

① mess: a very tidy condition
② base: the highest part of something
③ stuck: possible to move from a position
④ divide: to separate something into two or more parts or pieces
⑤ challenge: the way in which two people are connected with each other
questions.explanation: ④번이 정답입니다. ①은 'mess'는 '엉망인 상태'이므로 'a very untidy condition'이어야 합니다. ②는 'base'는 '기초, 밑'이므로 'the lowest part'입니다. ③은 'stuck'는 '움직일 수 없는'이므로 'not possible to move from a position'입니다. ⑤는 'challenge'는 '도전' 또는 '도전 과제'이므로 올바른 뜻풀이가 아닙니다.

questions.question:
다음 중 어법상 올바른 것을 있는 대로 묶은 것은?

㉠ That I said is true.
㉡ Don't tell her which I said.
㉢ He always did what he believed was right.
㉣ My dad bought me that I wanted yesterday.
㉤ Show me the thing which you have in your hand.
questions.explanation: ㉢과 ㉤이 어법상 올바릅니다. ㉠은 'What I said is true'로 수정되어야 합니다(관계대명사절에서 선행사가 없을 때 'that' 대신 'what' 사용). ㉡은 'Don't tell her what I said'로 수정되어야 합니다. ㉣은 'My dad bought me what I wanted yesterday'로 수정되어야 합니다. ㉢의 'what'과 ㉤의 'which'는 모두 올바르게 사용되었습니다.

questions.question:
밑줄 친 ㉠~㉤ 중 어법상 올바르게 쓰이지 않은 것은?

1. A: Why were you late?
   B: The bus broke down ㉠ suddenly on the way here.
2. A: I'm really hungry.
   B: I'll ㉡ quickly make some food.
3. A: You and Jisu are very ㉢ different.
   B: That's why we're best friends.
4. A: The cookies look ㉣ deliciously.
   B: Yeah. It's not ㉤ easy to eat just one.
questions.explanation: ㉣ 'deliciously'는 어법상 올바르지 않습니다. 'look'은 연결동사(linking verb)이므로 뒤에 형용사가 와야 합니다. 따라서 'delicious'로 수정되어야 합니다. ㉠, ㉡, ㉢, ㉤은 모두 올바르게 사용되었습니다.

options:
A: Ann, you look upset. What's wrong?
B: I lost my dog. I've been looking for him since last night.
A: Oh no. I hope you find him soon.
B: Yeah, you too.

A: Mina, how have you been?
B: I've been good. How is everything?
A: Pretty good My new classmates are nice.
B: Sounds good.

A: Bob, you look happy.
B: I came in first in the marathon.
A: I'm happy to hear that.
B: Thanks.

A: Amy, how have you been?
B: I've been great. How about you, Mike?
A: Not so good. I have a bad cold.
B: Oh, no! Get well soon.
A: Our team got an A on the science project.
B: That's great!
A: Our team had the best teamwork.
B: I'm happy to hear that.
questions.question: 다음 대화 중 자연스럽지 않은 것은?
questions.explanation: 대화문의 상황은 B가 강아지를 잃어버린 상황이다. 이 때 A가 강아지를 빨리 찾길 바란다고 말한 것에 대해 B가 'you too'라고 대답한 것은 문맥상 적절하지 않다.

questions.question:
다음 세 문장의 빈칸에 공통으로 들어갈 알맞은 전치사는?
- His house is always _____ a mess.
- I left _____ a hurry, and forgot the ticket.
- They set up the tent _____ the campground.
questions.explanation: in a mess는 '어질러져서'이고, in a hurry는 '서둘러'라는 뜻이다. 전치사 in은 장소를 가리킬 때 사용된다.

questions.question:
<보기>에서 어법상 적절한 문장을 있는 대로 고른 짝지은 것은?

<보기>
(A) We couldn't believe that we saw.
(B) This is different from what I expected.
(C) It was careless of him to say such a thing.
(D) Show me the thing what you have in your bag.
(E) It is important for we to finish the work on time.
questions.explanation: (A) 완전하지 않은 문장이 이어지는 관계대명사 절 앞에 선행사가 없으므로 선행사를 포함한 관계대명사 what으로 고쳐야 한다. (B) 선행사가 없고 불완전한 문장이 이어지므로 관계대명사 what이 적절히 쓰였다. (C) 사람의 태도를 나타내는 형용사가 쓰였으므로 to 부정사의 의미상 주어가 'of + 목적격'의 형태로 올바르게 쓰였다. (D) 선행사 the thing이 있고 목적어가 빠진 문장이 이어지므로 목적격 관계대명사 that/which로 고쳐야 한다. (E) to 부정사의 의미상 주어는 'for + 목적격'의 형태이므로 for us로 고쳐야 한다.

options: Be careful not to survive the cup.
It is important to think creatively.
He was in a hurry to arrive on time.
I divided the pizza into eight pieces.

questions.question: 밑줄 친 단어가 문맥상, 어법상 적절하지 않은 것은?
questions.explanation: survive는 자동사로 쓰는 경우 '살아남다'라는 뜻으로 목적어를 취하지 않으므로 뒤에 the cup이 올 수 없다. 타동사로 쓰는 경우에도 '~보다 더 오래 살다'라는 뜻인데 '컵보다 오래 살지 않도록 조심해라'라는 내용은 어색하다. 따라서 survive의 쓰임이 적절하지 않다.
